market.headline: Futures are bouncing (QQQ 670.87, SPY 737.29) on relief after Nvidia's results and excitement about Anthropic's IPO. But Fed minutes show officials expect more rate hikes, the 10-year yield is at 5.1% and the VIX is 25.46, so treat this as a bounce up into resistance, not a new uptrend.
watch: 09:30–10:30: QQQ must hold 662.8 (yesterday's high); its 200-day average at 681.8 is the ceiling
SPY 730.02 (200-day average): a close below it means the selloff resumes
Nov 25 08:30: PCE inflation and GDP. A hot number on top of rate-hike talk hits the most expensive stocks hardest
market.if_then: If QQQ falls back below 662.8 in the first hour, then stand aside and buy nothing today.

stocks.headline: Revenue grew 106% and guidance was in line, yet the stock fell 2.9% to 150.96 after the report.
stocks.why: The business is the strongest on this list: sales are speeding up, 65% operating margin, and it trades at 9× next year's profit, the cheapest in 5 years. The stock is falling for reasons outside the numbers. Huang is out, Kress is interim CEO, and the company says it won't file its quarterly 10-Q report for weeks. Investors won't pay up until that report is filed. Guidance only met expectations, so nothing in the report pushed back against the scandal. Money is also moving to AMD and to the coming Anthropic IPO. While NVDA stays weak it holds back MU, TSM, SMCI and ARM.

long_term.reason: Profits and forecasts are rising fast and the price is cheap. But the delayed 10-Q and the leadership change are open risks, so don't add until the filing is in.

stocks.what_would_change_it: If the 10-Q is filed with no surprises and the stock closes above 159.7, the stance moves to Add on dips. A close below 148.8 before the filing keeps it at Hold with no buying.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Holders keep their shares. Add nothing today, even near 148.8, until the 10-Q is filed.

levels.means: Above = the post-earnings selling is over. Below = sellers are still in control.
Above = it has won back the whole post-report drop. Below = the report is still being sold.
Below = a new low with no support nearby, so don't catch it.

stocks.if_then: If it trades below 148.8, then sell nothing, buy nothing, and wait for the 10-Q.

stocks.headline: Up 3.8% premarket to 293.22, carried by the Anthropic IPO, where Google is the second-largest holder.
stocks.why: The Anthropic stake is real value the market is now putting a price on. The stock is also cheap: 15× last year's profit, the lowest in 5 years, with a $567.7B contracted backlog. But last quarter profit per share fell 26% and missed forecasts by 30%, because AI spending is growing faster than sales. Large school districts are now weighing dropping Search over its forced AI features. The gap takes the price straight to its 20-day average at 294.77, where sellers stepped in during the slide. AMZN rides the same Anthropic story. AVGO, a Google chip supplier, also benefits if Google's mood improves.

long_term.reason: The price is cheap and the backlog is huge. But profits are shrinking, and one positive story doesn't fix that.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Two closes above 294.77 with no new estimate cuts would move it to Add on dips.
stocks.action: Don't chase the gap. If it falls back to 284.97, the Anthropic pop has failed, so stay out.

levels.means: Above = the gap is real and the downtrend is pausing. Below = the gap is being sold.
Above = the bounce is still alive. Below = the gap has faded into yesterday's range.
Above = the 20-day low holds. Below = the slide resumes.

stocks.if_then: If it holds above 294.77 after 10:30, then drop the avoid bet and stand aside.
